title: Reading lab: Romans 5:1–5
subtitle: Read a compact argumentative chain with care.
overview: Romans 5:1–5 develops an argumentative sequence. Identify the opening claim, each καί addition, and the causal γάρ clause before exploring vocabulary.
The lesson’s target is structure, not settling every debated theological or lexical question in the paragraph.

items.grc: δικαιωθέντες οὖν ἐκ πίστεως εἰρήνην ἔχομεν πρὸς τὸν θεὸν.
items.en: Therefore, having been justified by faith, we have peace with God.

items.grc: ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ θεοῦ ἐκκέχυται ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ἡμῶν διὰ πνεύματος ἁγίου.
items.en: The love of God has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit.
